name: Never delete recordings or user data files
description: Never delete recording files or any user-generated data files without explicit confirmation
type: feedback
---

Never delete files in `packages/scripts/e2e/recordings/` or any user-generated data/output files.

**Why:** User explicitly said "never remove recordings!" — recordings represent real user work and are not safe to delete just to fix a code bug. They may be the only copy of a recorded flow.

**How to apply:** Never `rm`, `fs.
